grid.title: RELATÓRIO RESUMO PIS/COFINS PARA CONFERÊNCIA - ANALÍTICO
grid.expression: SELECT TIPO, ENTSAI, SEQUENCIA, CODEMP, NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, CODTIPOPER, CODPARC, NOMEPARC, CODPROD, DESCRPROD, QTDNEG, VLRUNIT, CODCFO, CODTRIB, SUM(BASEICMS) AS BASEICMS, MAX(ALIQICMS) AS ALIQICMS, SUM(VLRICMS) AS VLRICMS, CSTIPI, /*VLRNOTA*/ IDENTINSCESTAD, CHAVENFE, NCM, CLASSIFICMS, SUM(VLRTOT) AS VLRTOT, SUM(BASEIPI) AS BASEIPI, SUM(VLRIPI) AS VLRIPI, SUM(BASERED_PIS) AS BASERED_PIS, SUM(BASERED_COFINS) AS BASERED_COFINS, SUM(VALOR_PIS) AS VALOR_PIS, SUM(VALOR_COFINS) AS VALOR_COFINS, MAX(CST_PIS) AS CST_PIS, MAX(CST_COFINS) AS CST_COFINS, MAX(ALIQUOTA_PIS) AS ALIQUOTA_PIS, MAX(ALIQUOTA_COFINS) AS ALIQUOTA_COFINS, SUM(FRETE_ITEM) AS FRETE_ITEM FROM (SELECT 'A170' AS TIPO, LIS.ENTSAI, LIS.SEQUENCIA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODTIPOPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, ITE.CODCFO, ITE.CODTRIB, ITE.BASEICMS, ITE.ALIQICMS, ITE.VLRICMS, ITE.CSTIPI, CAB.VLRNOTA, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CAB.CHAVENFE, PRO.NCM, CASE WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'R' THEN 'Revendedor' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'C' THEN 'Consumidor Final' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'X' THEN 'Consumidor Contribuinte' ELSE '-----' END AS CLASSIFICMS, (CASE WHEN DIN.CODINC=0 THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) AS VLRTOT, 0 AS BASEIPI, 0 AS VLRIPI, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_PIS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_COFINS, 0 AS FRETE_ITEM FROM TGFLIS LIS INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (ITE.NUNOTA = LIS.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = LIS.SEQUENCIA) INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON (LIS.NUNOTA = DIN.NUNOTA AND LIS.SEQUENCIA = DIN.SEQUENCIA) INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE EXISTS((SELECT DISTINCT LIS1.NUNOTA FROM TGFLIS LIS1 WHERE (LIS.DTMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (LIS1.DTMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND (LIS1.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND LIS1.ORIGEM <> 'F' AND ((LIS1.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIS1.ENTSAI = 'E' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D1 WHERE D1.NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND D1.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (((D1.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D1.VLRCRED,0) <> 0) AND D1.CST IN (50,51,52,53,54,55,56,60,61,62,63,64,65,66))))) OR (LIS1.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIS1.ENTSAI = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN WHERE NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND CODIMP IN (6,7)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT LIV.NUNOTA FROM TGFLIV LIV WHERE LIV.NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND LIV.ORIGEM = LIS1.ORIGEM) AND LIS1.NUNOTA = LIS.NUNOTA)) AND (LIS.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND LIS.ORIGEM = 'E' AND DIN.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) AND ITE.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND ITE.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'C170' AS TIPO, LIV.ENTSAI, LIV.SEQUENCIA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODTIPOPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, ITE.CODCFO, ITE.CODTRIB, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN LIV.BASEICMS ELSE 0 END AS BASEICMS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN LIV.ALIQICMS ELSE 0 END AS ALIQICMS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN LIV.VLRICMS ELSE 0 END AS VLRICMS, ITE.CSTIPI, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN CAB.VLRNOTA ELSE 0 END AS VLRNOTA, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CAB.CHAVENFE, PRO.NCM, CASE WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'R' THEN 'Revendedor' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'C' THEN 'Consumidor Final' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'X' THEN 'Consumidor Contribuinte' ELSE '-----' END AS CLASSIFICMS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN (CASE WHEN DIN.CODINC = 0 THEN CASE WHEN NVL(CAB.VLRLIQITEMNFE,'N') = 'N' THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(ITE.CODMOTDESONERAICMS, 0) != 0 THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC ELSE ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED END END ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS VLRTOT, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN ITE.BASEIPI ELSE 0 END AS BASEIPI, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END AS VLRIPI, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_PIS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_COFINS, CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 AND DIN.CODINC = 3 THEN DIN.BASE ELSE 0 END AS FRETE_ITEM FROM TGFLIV LIV, TGFITE ITE, TGFDIN DIN, TGFCAB CAB, TGFPRO PRO, TGFPAR PAR WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT DISTINCT LIV.ENTSAI, LIV.NUNOTA, LIV.ORIGEM, LIV.CODEMP, CAB1.CODTIPOPER, NVL(CASE WHEN LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E', 'A') THEN CAB1.STATUSNFE ELSE(SELECT CAB2.STATUSNFE FROM TGFCAB CAB2 WHERE CAB2.NUNOTA = ABS(LIV.NUNOTA) AND CAB2.STATUSNFE = 'D') END, 'N') AS STATUSNFE FROM TGFLIV LIV LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB1 ON LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E','A') AND LIV.NUNOTA = CAB1.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFTPV TPV ON CAB1.CODTIPVENDA = TPV.CODTIPVENDA AND CAB1.DHTIPVENDA = TPV.DHALTER LEFT JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON CAB1.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB1.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER, TGFRGM RGM WHERE (LIV.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (RGM.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND ('01/01/2021' BETWEEN RGM.DTINIREGIME AND NVL(RGM.DTFIMREGIME,SYSDATE)) AND (LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND LIV.CODMODDOC IN (1, 4, 55, 65, 901) AND (LIV.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND CAB1.TIPMOV <> 'D' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D1 WHERE D1.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D1.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D1.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (((D1.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D1.VLRCRED,0) <> 0) AND D1.CST IN (50,51,52,53,54,55,56,60,61,62,63,64,65,66)) OR ((SELECT T.LOGICO AS LOGICO FROM TSIPAR T WHERE T.CHAVE = 'CSTSEMCREDEFDCT') = 'S' AND D1.CST IN (70,71,72,73,74,75))) ) OR (LIV.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND CAB1.TIPMOV = 'D' AND LIV.CODCFO IN (1201,1202,1203,1204,1410,1411,1660,1661,1662,2201,2202,2203,2204,2410,2411,2660,2661,2662,3201,3202,3211,3503,3553) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D1 WHERE D1.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D1.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D1.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (((D1.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D1.VLRCRED,0) <> 0) AND ((RGM.CODINCTRIB IN (1,3) AND D1.CST IN (50,51,52,53,54,55,56,60,61,62,63,64,65,66)) OR (RGM.CODINCTRIB IN (2,3) AND D1.CST IN (98,99)))) OR ((SELECT T.LOGICO AS LOGICO FROM TSIPAR T WHERE T.CHAVE = 'CSTSEMCREDEFDCT') = 'S' AND RGM.CODINCTRIB IN (1,3) AND D1.CST IN (70,71,72,73,74,75)))) ) OR /* PREOCUPAR COM C100,C180,C190 */ (LIV.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'S' AND CAB1.TIPMOV <> 'E' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D2 WHERE D2.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D2.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D2.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (D2.CST <> 49 OR LIV.CODCFO = 5927)) ) OR (LIV.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'S' AND CAB1.TIPMOV = 'E' AND LIV.CODCFO IN (5201,5202,5205,5206,5207,5210,5410,5411,5660,5661,5662,6201,6202,6205,6206,6207,6210,6410,6411,6660,6661,6662,7201,7202,7205,7206,7207,7210,7211) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D2 WHERE D2.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D2.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D2.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND D2.CST = 49) ) OR (LIV.ORIGEM = 'A' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D3 WHERE D3.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D3.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D3.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND D3.CST <> 49 AND (LIV.ENTSAI = 'S' OR D3.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D3.VLRCRED,0) <> 0)) ) OR (LIV.ORIGEM = 'C') )) C100 WHERE (C100.STATUSNFE <> 'D' OR C100.ORIGEM <> 'C' OR C100.CODTIPOPER <> NVL(NVL((SELECT EMP.CODTIPOPERACOMP FROM TGFEMP EMP WHERE EMP.CODEMP = C100.CODEMP) , (SELECT INTEIRO FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'TOPIMPFISCAL') ) ,-1) ) AND C100.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA) AND ITE.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND ITE.NUNOTA = DIN.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = DIN.SEQUENCIA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND DIN.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (LIV.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E','A') AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND (LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND CAB.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND CAB.NUNOTA = DIN.NUNOTA AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) AND ITE.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND ITE.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) UNION ALL --NOTAS FISCAIS FRETES SELECT 'D100' AS TIPO, LIV.ENTSAI, LIV.SEQUENCIA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODTIPOPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, ITE.CODCFO, ITE.CODTRIB /*ICMS*/ ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.BASE ELSE 0 END AS BASEICMS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQICMS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VLRICMS, ITE.CSTIPI ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN CAB.VLRNOTA ELSE 0 END AS VLRNOTA, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CAB.CHAVENFE ,PRO.NCM ,CASE WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'R' THEN 'Revendedor' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'C' THEN 'Consumidor Final' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'X' THEN 'Consumidor Contribuinte' ELSE '-----' END AS CLASSIFICMS --,(CASE WHEN DIN.CODINC= 0 THEN ITE.VLRTOT ELSE 0 END) AS VLRTOT ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN (CASE WHEN DIN.CODINC= 0 THEN ITE.VLRTOT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS VLRTOT --IPI ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN ITE.BASEIPI ELSE 0 END AS BASEIPI ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END AS VLRIPI --PIS/COFINS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_PIS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END AS BASERED_COFINS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_PIS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN CASE WHEN DIN.VLRCRED IS NOT NULL AND DIN.VLRCRED <> 0 THEN DIN.VLRCRED ELSE DIN.VALOR END ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_COFINS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_PIS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END AS CST_COFINS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_PIS ,CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.ALIQUOTA ELSE 0 END AS ALIQUOTA_COFINS ,CASE WHEN (DIN.CODIMP = 1 AND DIN.CODINC = 3) THEN DIN.BASE ELSE 0 END AS FRETE_ITEM FROM TGFLIV LIV INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON LIV.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E','A') INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPOCAB ON LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E','A') AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPOCAB.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPOCAB.DHALTER INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA, TSIEMP EMP, TGFDIN DIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFPRO PRO WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND ITE.NUNOTA = DIN.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = DIN.SEQUENCIA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND DIN.CODIMP IN (1, 6, 7) AND LIV.CODEMP = EMP.CODEMP AND (LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND (LIV.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND LIV.CODMODDOC IN (7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 26, 27, 57, 902) AND LIV.ORIGEM <> 'D' AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND CAB.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND CAB.NUNOTA = DIN.NUNOTA AND ((LIV.ORIGEM IN ('E','A') AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND CAB.TIPMOV <> 'D' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D1 WHERE D1.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND D1.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND D1.CODIMP IN (1,6,7) AND (D1.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D1.VLRCRED,0) <> 0) AND D1.CST IN (0,50,51,52,53,54,55,56,60,61,62,63,64,65,66) ) ) OR (LIV.ORIGEM = 'C') ) AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) AND ITE.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND ITE.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) ) V GROUP BY TIPO, ENTSAI, SEQUENCIA, CODEMP, NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, CODTIPOPER, CODPARC, NOMEPARC, CODPROD, DESCRPROD, QTDNEG, VLRUNIT, CODCFO, CSTIPI, CODTRIB, IDENTINSCESTAD, CHAVENFE, CLASSIFICMS,NCM ORDER BY TIPO, CODEMP, DTENTSAI, DTNEG, NUMNOTA, SEQUENCIA, ALIQUOTA_PIS, ALIQUOTA_COFINS
